Name: Prohibiting the use of stationary transport refrigeration units within applicable facilities.
Title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to prohibiting the use of stationary transport refrigeration units within applicable facilities
BodyName: Committee on Environmental Protection and Waterfronts

History.Description: This Introduction was Introduced by Council
This Introduction was Referred to Comm by Council to the Committee on Environmental Protection and Waterfronts

Summary: This bill would prohibit the use of diesel-powered stationary transport refrigeration units within the boundaries of certain facilities such as large warehouses and distribution centers, large grocery stores, marine terminals, and intermodal railyards. The bill would also establish penalties for the use of diesel-powered stationary transport refrigeration units at such facilities. Finally, the bill would exclude battery- and shore-powered stationary transport refrigeration units from such prohibition.
Text:
A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to prohibiting the use of stationary transport refrigeration units within applicable facilities

Be it enacted by the Council as follows:


Section 1. Subchapter 7 of chapter 1 of title 24 of the administrative code of the city of New York is amended by adding a new section 24-167.1 to read as follows:
§ 24-167.1 Transport refrigeration units. a. Definitions. For purposes of this section, the following terms have the following meanings:
Applicable facility. The term “applicable facility” means any of the following facilities:
1. a refrigerated warehouse facility or distribution center, including but not limited to a cold storage warehouse, packing house, cross-dock facility, or third-party logistics center, that is comprised of 1 or more buildings on the same tax lot that together exceed 50,000 gross square feet;
2. a grocery store with a building size greater than or equal to 15,000 square feet;
3. a marine terminal; or 
4. an intermodal railyard.
Generator set. The term “generator set” means a compression ignition engine coupled to a generator used as a source of electricity.
Transport refrigeration unit. The term “transport refrigeration unit” means a refrigeration system powered by integral internal combustion engines designed to control the environment of temperature sensitive products that are transported in trucks and refrigerated trailers. 
b. No person shall use or permit the use of a diesel-powered transport refrigeration unit or a generator set powering a transport refrigeration unit while such transport refrigeration unit or generator set is fixed in a stationary location within an applicable facility. 
§ 2. The table of civil penalties in subparagraph (i) of paragraph (3) of subdivision (a) of section 24-178 of the administrative code of the city of New York is amended by adding after the row beginning 24-167 a civil penalty for a violation of section 24-167.1, to read as follows:

	Violation
	Minimum

	24-167.1
	$1,000
	$5,000
	
		§ 3. This local law takes effect 2 years after it becomes law.
